titulo: The Chupacabra Came Back for My Goats | Cryptid Horror #Shorts
titulo_pt: O chupacabra voltou pelas minhas cabras
resumo_pt: Um fazendeiro do Texas perde cabras, encontradas sem sangue. Ele filma o chupacabra no celeiro. Na manhã seguinte conta oito cabras: a oitava era o próprio monstro disfarçado.
descricao:
Seven goats. Then eight. Only one of them was real.

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: My goats vanished on our Texas farm.
scenes.pt: Minhas cabras sumiram na fazenda do Texas.
scenes.visual: small Texas farm at dusk, goat pen with a lantern, dark fields, the farmer at the fence

scenes.text: Then I saw it. Red eyes. Spines down its back.
scenes.pt: Aí eu vi. Olhos vermelhos. Espinhos nas costas.

scenes.text: Next morning, a goat lay in the grass.
scenes.pt: Na manhã seguinte, uma cabra estava caída no capim.
scenes.visual: still goat lying in tall grass at dawn, farmer standing over it
close up of a pale goat in cold morning light, no blood

scenes.text: The vet said something sucked it dry.
scenes.pt: O veterinário disse que algo a sugou.
scenes.visual: veterinarian in a barn kneeling beside a pale goat, serious face

scenes.text: So I set a camera in the barn.
scenes.pt: Então instalei uma câmera no celeiro.

farmer alone in a dark barn watching a monitor with a dim glow

scenes.text: At three a.m., the goats started screaming.
scenes.pt: Às três da manhã, as cabras começaram a gritar.
scenes.visual: goats in a pen panicking under moonlight, one raising its head
farmer running out of a barn door with a flashlight

scenes.text: It was crouched over the last one.
scenes.visual: chupacabra crouched over a goat in a pen under a barn light, red eyes

scenes.pt: Os olhos dele prenderam os meus.
scenes.visual: chupacabra turning its head, glowing red eyes staring at a farmer with a flashlight

scenes.text: Then it ran into the dark.
scenes.visual: dark empty pen with spilled feed and a fleeing shadow at the edge

scenes.text: Morning. I counted my goats. Seven.
scenes.pt: De manhã, contei as cabras. Sete.
scenes.visual: farmer at a fence counting goats in bright morning light
an extra goat in the herd with glowing red eyes, the others stepping away

scenes.text: The eighth goat was the chupacabra all along.
scenes.pt: A oitava cabra era o chupacabra o tempo todo.
scenes.visual: red-eyed creature wearing goat fur among the goats, spines hidden under the fur

scenes.text: It's still in my pen. Waiting for me to miscount.
scenes.pt: Ainda está no meu cercado. Esperando eu contar errado.
